edit.description: readLocalInstall/engineHandshake (~L98-258, self-ref guard from 54d0d70): self-reference becomes a distinct outcome — this invocation IS the provisioned install, proceed as authority (skip spawnSync re-exec, skip arm-2 pin refusal) — not indistinguishable from absent.
Retarget ~L506-577: pinned self-ref case now proceeds (no exit-2 refusal); unpinned self-ref case unchanged (still a no-op, no re-exec).
§4 handshake bullet: a self-referential provisioned install (e.g. a dogfood chain from a source checkout) proceeds as authority, not a refusal.

summary: Fix pin-handshake self-reference guard (54d0d70): proceed as authority instead of falling through to arm-2 refusal, unwedging every repo-root-pinned bay

per.section: 10. Engine↔pin handshake via launcher-defers-to-pin (the gradlew pattern)

tests.asserts: self-referential local install on a pinned bay proceeds (no re-exec spawn, no exit-2 refusal) instead of hitting arm 2

acceptance: pinned bay whose provisioned install real-path-resolves to the running engine itself runs normally (previously exit 2); unpinned self-ref case still a no-op; full handshake suite green
notes: Routed from inbox 2026-07-30 (temper 0.6->0.8 migration friction, finding 1). Self-ref guard (54d0d70) prevents an infinite re-exec loop but conflates 'this IS the install' with 'nothing provisioned', so a pinned+provisioned dogfood-shaped bay always refuses -- no pinned layout can run. Consider a 0.8.1 patch cut once shipped.

edit.description: PendingGateOptions gains optional fenceWhen?: (entry: PendingEntry) => boolean (default () => true, preserves current behavior); only entries where fenceWhen(entry) is true are fence-checked (~L199-266).
Add pendingGate fenceWhen cases: default fences every entry (current behavior unchanged); a supplied predicate exempts e.g. parked/deferred entries from the fence check.

summary: Add a fenceWhen predicate to pendingGate so chains can exempt park-exempt entries from the fence pre-check, retiring hand-rolled forks

per.section: 6. `pendingGate`: composed validation and fence pre-check as a builtin

tests.asserts: an entry excluded by fenceWhen ships even when its files fall outside targetFence; an included entry is still checked

acceptance: pendingGate({ ..., fenceWhen }) skips the fence check for entries fenceWhen returns false for; omitting fenceWhen behaves exactly as today
notes: Routed from inbox 2026-07-30 (temper migration friction, finding 2). A predicate, not a pickableOnly boolean (per engine-boundary.md's mechanism-vs-convention test): the engine ships the injection point, the chain owns which gate.kind values count as park-exempt.
